articles.title: A Giant Ghost-Catcher 700 Meters Underground Just Snagged Its First Big Clue!
articles.summary: A huge detector in China caught ghostly particles called neutrinos. It measured two secrets about how they change shape. The results are 1.6 times more precise than before.

articles.title: Alaska's Glaciers Are Melting Way Faster Than We Thought—Here's the 3-Week Surprise
articles.summary: For every 1°C of summer warming, Alaska's glaciers melt three weeks longer. Satellites that see through clouds revealed this. Heat waves can strip 28% more protective snow.

articles.title: Rice Has a Secret Superpower: It Gets Weaker When You Squeeze It Fast!
articles.summary: Packed rice grains weaken when squeezed quickly, unlike most materials. Scientists used this to make a smart material that can bend or stiffen on its own, without electronics.
